anti_duplication: one canonical parameterised recipe per process strategy/component family where possible
assemblies reference child recipe/build URIs and store only placement, interface, dependency and override deltas
machine dialect is generated late from a frozen manufacturing IR and current calibrated machine manifest
simulation refinement creates a new digital revision and never mutates prior reviewed evidence
minimal_scope_rule: Solve only dimensions that can materially change process feasibility, component state, acceptance or safety. Exact source/process evidence may add scopes; it may not silently remove a consequential one.
physical_boundary: No compiler, simulation, schedule, render or generated program raises physical evidence or execution authority. Machine execution remains separately gated by BUILD_READY, exact machine/adapter/calibration identity, independent C0/interlocks and required owner/specialist authority.
